en.title: The infinitive
en.summary: The infinitive is the base form of the verb, usually preceded by to.

paragraphs: The infinitive is the base form of the verb, the form that a dictionary gives. It names the action without showing person, number or tense. In English it is usually preceded by to, but after some verbs it appears without to. The infinitive is used after many verbs and adjectives, and to show purpose.

The infinitive with to follows many verbs and adjectives, such as want, hope, decide, easy and ready. After modal verbs, and after let, make and help, it appears without to. To make it negative, put not before to. Never put a word between to and the verb in careful writing, though speakers sometimes do.

blocks.html:
FormExample
with toI hope to see you.
without to (modal)She can sing.
without to (let, make)He made me laugh.
negativeTry not to be late.
purposeI went out to buy bread.

paragraphs: To explain why we do something, we use to plus the base form: She studies to become a doctor. For emphasis we can say in order to: He left early in order to catch the train. We do not use for with a verb in this meaning.

The infinitive without to is called the bare infinitive. It follows can, could, may, might, must, shall, should, will and would. It also follows the verbs of perception see and hear in some patterns: I saw him leave.

items: Wrong: **She can to swim.** Right: **She can swim.**
Wrong: **I went there for buy bread.** Right: **I went there to buy bread.**
Wrong: **He made me to laugh.** Right: **He made me laugh.**

ro.title: Infinitivul
ro.summary: Infinitivul este forma de bază a verbului și începe de obicei cu particula „a”.

paragraphs: Infinitivul este forma de bază a unui verb. Găsim această formă în dicționar. În limba română, infinitivul are de obicei particula „a” în față.

items: Am venit pentru **a vorbi** cu tine.

paragraphs: Infinitivul se termină în -a, -ea, -e, -i sau -î. În vorbire, nu spunem „vreau a merge”, ci „vreau să merg”. Folosim infinitivul mai ales după prepoziții ca „pentru” sau „fără”. De asemenea, el poate funcționa ca substantiv.

blocks.html:
TerminațieFormăExemplu
-aa învățapentru a învăța
-eaa vedeafără a vedea
-ea mergepentru a merge
-i / -îa citi / a coborîA citi este util.
